clips.title: The story
paras: Grund and Gozwin recounts an ambush at a campsite in the snowy northwestern hills, where a dwarf and a gnome were attacked by a predatory snow leopard. Although the gnome survived thanks to his partner's shotgun, his prized mechanic's log was left behind in the commotion. Adventurers are sent into the hills to recover the delicate notes and slay the stalking beast.

While traveling together in the snowy hills, the dwarf Grund and his gnomish companion Gozwin set up an encampment for the evening. As Grund turned his back to prep a boar over the fire, a snow leopard prowler lunged from the brush and grabbed Gozwin in its jaws. Reacting instantly, Grund grabbed his trusty shotgun and blasted a round over the beast's head, startling the predator into dropping the gnome and fleeing into the cold crags.

Although Gozwin escaped the jaws of the cat with deep scratches rather than fatal injuries, their camp was thoroughly disrupted. In the chaos of the retreat, Gozwin dropped his prized Mechanic's Log—a technical notebook containing critical schematics for his mecha-walker. Terribly anxious that someone might discover his engineering secrets, the battered gnome could not rest until an adventurer agreed to venture northwest into the hills to reclaim his book and slay the prowling predator.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.
Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.
Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!
Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.
Thanks, friend. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
